verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a product that ships a CLI and agent-facing MCP servers, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The cart attribution fields (UTM and click IDs) are tracking metadata the agent can supply, not a user opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
